methodology.elo: Existing frozen Elo parameters and probability/update formulas; batches by date; current day excluded. Current-season update covers archived Champions results only, not Europa/Conference.
methodology.domestic: Last eight archived current-season domestic games. Points minus frozen-Elo expected points; only exact provider-ID or explicit canonicalTeamId to canonical UEFA-ID matches. ESPN IDs never reused for other providers. Full adjustment N/D unless all opponents covered; subset explicitly separate. No league-to-probability conversion.
methodology.shots: Raw domestic shot difference only; not opponent-adjusted, not used in rating. xG unavailable.
methodology.validation: Retrospective chronological replay of archived results, not a prospectively frozen forecast. Original result acquisition timestamps were not enforced. No domestic/shot composite fitted or validated.
methodology.reliability: Sample counts and historical-rating availability only; no calibrated confidence score.
methodology.league: Frozen European-qualifier association median, not whole domestic league strength.

validation.conclusion: No improvement on both metrics in this archived sample; do not activate.
